findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "compare_llm_hosting" is 864 chars, far longer than this server's median (112). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_article · Private data: get_profile, compare_llm_hosting, compare_mcp_context_cost · Public sink: compare_mcp_context_cost · Destructive: compare_llm_hosting.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_article · Private data: get_profile, compare_llm_hosting, compare_mcp_context_cost · Public sink: compare_mcp_context_cost · Destructive: compare_llm_hosting

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare_llm_hosting" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
